title: A Tale of Two Monopolies
abstract: arXiv:2506.06763v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We apply marginal analysis \`a la Bulow and Roberts (1989) to characterize revenue-maximizing selling mechanisms for a multiproduct monopoly. We derive marginal revenue from price perturbations over arbitrary sets of bundles and show that optimal mechanisms admit no revenue-increasing perturbation for bundles with positive demand, nor revenue-decreasing perturbations for zero-demand bundles. For any symmetric two-dimensional type distribution under mild regularity, this analysis fully characterizes the optimal mechanism across independence, substitutability, and complementarity. For general type distributions and allocation spaces, our approach identifies bundles that must carry positive demand and provides conditions under which pure bundling or separate selling is suboptimal.

translated_abstract: 我们运用Bulow和Roberts（1989）式的边际分析方法来刻画多产品垄断者收益最大化的销售机制。我们从任意捆绑集合上的价格扰动中推导出边际收益，并证明最优机制对于具有正需求的捆绑不允许任何增加收益的扰动，对于零需求的捆绑也不允许任何减少收益的扰动。对于任意对称的二维类型分布，在温和的正则性条件下，该分析在独立性、替代性和互补性情形下完整刻画了最优机制。对于一般的类型分布和配置空间，我们的方法识别出必须具有正需求的捆绑，并给出了纯捆绑销售或分开销售为次优的条件。
tldr: 该论文将Bulow-Roberts边际分析方法推广至多产品垄断定价，通过价格扰动刻画收益最大化销售机制，并在对称二维类型分布下完整求解了独立、替代与互补情形下的最优机制。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Bulow-Roberts marginal analysis to multiproduct monopoly pricing, characterizing revenue-maximizing selling mechanisms via price perturbations and fully solving the optimal mechanism for symmetric two-dimensional type distributions under independence, substitutability, and complementarity.
